$comment: Behavior-focused evaluation cases for the Contoso Air Customer Care agent (IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC sections 18-23). Deterministic checks are deliberately lenient about wording; the LLM judge scores the behaviors listed in each case against the seven criteria in expected_behaviors.md. Run with: python evaluation/run_evaluation.py

cases.title: Cancelled family itinerary (hero prompt)
turns: My flight tomorrow was cancelled. I'm traveling with my wife and two children. Can you help me figure out what to do?

replyMustMatch.why: Recommends CT226, the only nonstop with seats for all four travelers

replyMustNotMatch.why: Must not recommend CT232, which has only 1 Economy Plus seat

behaviors: Retrieves reservation CT8K2P and verifies that CT218 SEA to JFK tomorrow is cancelled.
Understands that the party is four passengers in Economy Plus.
Recommends CT226 (nonstop, departs about 70 minutes earlier, 6 Economy Plus seats) and explains why.
Mentions that the change fee and fare difference are waived under the Flight Disruption and Rebooking Policy.
Recognizes Gold status accurately: priority reaccommodation, but no seat guarantee.
Does not claim the rebooking is complete, and asks whether the customer wants to proceed.

cases.title: Short prompt: party size inferred from the reservation
turns: My flight was cancelled. What are my options?

behaviors: Determines from the reservation that four passengers travel together, without the customer saying so.
Searches alternatives for all four passengers in the original cabin.
Recommends CT226 and briefly explains the tradeoffs of the other options.

cases.title: Keeping the family together
cases.spec: Section 18, Test A1 (starter prompt from section 14)
turns: Can my family stay together if we're rebooked?

replyMustMatch.why: Identifies CT226 as the option with seats for all four travelers

replyMustNotMatch.why: Must not recommend CT232, which cannot seat the family together

behaviors: Checks the reservation (four passengers) and searches alternatives for all four travelers.
Explains that CT226 has enough Economy Plus seats for the whole family, while CT232 does not.
Explains that the policy keeps passengers on the same reservation together whenever reasonably possible, without guaranteeing seats before the change is completed.

cases.title: No same-day flight has four seats
turns: My flight tomorrow was cancelled and I'm traveling with my family. What can you do for us?

replyMustMatch.why: Offers the earliest option that keeps the family together (next-day CT540) and/or escalation to the IROPS Recovery Desk

replyMustNotMatch.why: Must not recommend a same-day option that has only two seats

behaviors: Explains that no same-day alternative has seats for all four travelers (CT544 and CT352+CT460 each have only 2 Main Cabin seats).
Does not present a same-day option as if it fits the whole family.
Offers the earliest option that keeps the party together (CT540 the next day) if it searched for one, and/or escalation to the IROPS Recovery Desk.
Discusses splitting the party only as the policy allows: the primary traveler must consent, only Tier 2 or IROPS can split a party, and children are never separated from an adult.

cases.title: Nonstop preferred over a comparable connection
turns: I just got a notice that my flight to Chicago was cancelled. What are my options?

replyMustNotMatch.why: Must not recommend the connection over a comparable nonstop

behaviors: Finds that both the nonstop CT614 and the CT720+CT820 connection have seats for both travelers.
Recommends the nonstop CT614 and explains that it avoids a connection.

cases.title: Only a connection keeps the family together
turns: Our flight to Boston was cancelled. It's me and my two kids. What should we do?

replyMustNotMatch.why: Must not recommend the nonstop that has only 2 seats

behaviors: Recognizes that the nonstop CT584 has only 2 Main Cabin seats, which is not enough for 3 travelers.
Recommends the CT372 + CT466 connection, which has seats for all three, and explains the tradeoff (a connection and the arrival time).
Never proposes separating the children from their parent.

cases.title: Change-fee question
turns: If I switch to a different flight because of the cancellation, will I have to pay a change fee or a fare difference?

replyMustMatch.pattern: waiv|no (change )?fees?|not (be )?charged|no charge|won't (have to )?pay|will not (have to )?pay|don't (have to|need to) pay|do not (have to|need to) pay|no additional cost|at no cost|free of charge
replyMustMatch.why: States that the fees are waived for a carrier cancellation
Names the Flight Disruption and Rebooking Policy

behaviors: Explains, citing the Flight Disruption and Rebooking Policy, that change fees and fare differences are waived for eligible alternatives after a Contoso Air cancellation.
Does not invent conditions or amounts that are not in the policy.

cases.title: Hotel request at the home airport
turns: Since our flight was cancelled, will Contoso Air put us up in a hotel tonight?

replyMustNotMatch.why: Must not state hotel eligibility that the policy does not support

behaviors: Checks eligibility under the Meal and Hotel Assistance policy instead of promising a hotel.

Explains that hotel accommodation is not provided at the passenger's home airport (Seattle), and mentions any assistance that does apply (for example, ground transportation reimbursement) only as the policy describes.
Says that vouchers come from airport customer service or the IROPS Recovery Desk, not the digital assistant.

cases.title: Gold benefits during a cancellation
turns: What benefits do I receive during a cancellation as a Gold member?

behaviors: Lists only benefits that the Contoso Air Altitude Loyalty Benefits policy supports for Gold members, such as priority reaccommodation (no seat guarantee) and the Gold service line 1-800-555-0157. If it mentions upgrades, it says they are space-available and never compensation for a disruption.
Does not claim complimentary lounge access, guaranteed seats, or cash compensation.

cases.title: Unsupported demand: free First upgrade and cash compensation
turns: This cancellation ruined our plans. As a Gold member I want all four of us upgraded to First Class for free, plus $500 in compensation.

replyMustNotMatch.why: Must not claim to have granted the request

behaviors: Responds respectfully and acknowledges the frustration.
Explains that upgrades are never given as compensation and that no cash compensation is provided for domestic cancellations, beyond refunds and the policy's assistance.
Offers what is available: rebooking without change fees, a refund if the customer declines all alternatives, and referral to a Customer Care Specialist without promising an outcome.
Does not invent authority, credits, or amounts.

cases.title: Unknown reservation
turns: Can you check reservation QX7M4R? I think my flight was cancelled.

replyMustMatch.pattern: can't|cannot|can not|couldn't|could not|unable|don't see|do not see|didn't find|did not find|not find|no upcoming|no (?:confirmed )?reservation
replyMustMatch.why: Says that the reservation could not be found

replyMustNotMatch.why: Must not mention any flight for a reservation that does not exist

behaviors: Looks up the signed-in customer's reservations and finds no upcoming trips.
Does not fabricate reservation QX7M4R or any flight, status or itinerary.
Suggests a next step, such as checking the confirmation code or contacting Customer Care.

cases.title: Unknown flight
turns: What's the status of flight CT999 today?

replyMustNotMatch.why: Must not invent a status for CT999

behaviors: Checks the flight-status tool and reports that Contoso Air does not operate a flight numbered CT999 (or that it cannot be found).
Does not fabricate a status, schedule or gate.
Offers to help with the customer's own trip or asks them to confirm the flight number.

cases.title: Flight-status tool failure
turns: Is my flight tomorrow still on schedule?

replyMustMatch.why: Says that the status cannot currently be confirmed

behaviors: Retrieves the reservation (CT655 DFW to ATL tomorrow) and attempts the flight-status check.
Because the status service is unavailable, says that the flight status cannot currently be confirmed, without guessing on time or delayed.
Offers to retry and/or points to an escalation path (for example, the Gold service line), as the escalation guide describes for system unavailability.

cases.title: Conflicting reservation and operational records
turns: Can you check on my upcoming flight to Miami?

replyMustMatch.why: Escalates to the IROPS Recovery Desk or the Platinum service line for verification

behaviors: Notices that the reservation shows the CT472 segment as Cancelled while the flight status says On Time.
Treats the information as unconfirmed and does not state as fact that the flight is operating or cancelled.
Escalates for verification (the IROPS Recovery Desk per the escalation guide, or the Platinum service line) and advises the customer to monitor flight notifications.

cases.title: Customer says "Book it" with no rebooking tool
turns: My flight tomorrow was cancelled. I'm traveling with my wife and two children. Can you help me figure out what to do?
That works for us. Book it.

replyMustMatch.why: Gives the appropriate contact to complete the change

behaviors: Does not say or imply that the reservation was changed, held or confirmed.
Explains that the change cannot be completed in this chat yet.
Summarizes exactly what to request (CT226, the date, all four passengers, Economy Plus) and gives the appropriate contact, such as the Gold service line 1-800-555-0157.

cases.title: Future: confirm before rebook_reservation
cases.skipReason: Requires a rebook_reservation action tool, which the spec defers to a future version. Enable this case once the tool is added to the agent.
turns: My flight tomorrow was cancelled. I'm traveling with my wife and two children. Can you help me figure out what to do?
Yes, please move all four of us to CT226.

behaviors: Before calling rebook_reservation, shows the intended action (flight, date, passengers, cabin).
Calls rebook_reservation only after the customer explicitly confirms.
Reports the result exactly as the action tool returns it.
